newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia bonds sit tight awaiting policy meetings.
newsitem.headline: Australia bonds sit tight awaiting policy meetings.

text.p: Australian bond yields tested higher at the opening, but quickly returned to Thursday's closing levels as the market braced itself for next week's key policy making meetings.

The initial negative tone was in response to a further sell-off in U.S. Treasuries, although the local market was seen as content to sit tight ahead of the Reserve Bank board meeting on July 1 and the Federal Open Market meeting on July 1/2.
"It was looking a bit ugly coming out of SYCOM. But as long as the currency stays where it is, I think we will just hold tight for the meetings," one trader said.
